meta.name: pr-review-comments
meta.description: Posts review findings from a JSON file as inline comments on a GitHub Pull Request, attaching each comment to its file and line. Use when you have a list/JSON of review findings (each with a file path, line number, and a message such as summary/failure_scenario) and want them published on a PR as inline review comments. Triggers include "post these review comments on the PR", "associate comments to files in the PR", "publish review findings to PR

copy.tagline: 将审查结果作为行内评论发布到 GitHub PR 上
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有审查结果 JSON 并想直接贴在 PR 对应行上
